purpose: Compare the legacy request role set with the formal Research OS low-usage topology without adding an extra model turn.
input_cutoff: PVA_AI_EXCHANGE_REQUEST_V1 before the paired response exists
eligible_pool: only work_items present in the request and already marked READY by the legacy orchestrator
logical_role_unit_definition: one role_result for one agent_id within one scheduled model turn; this is not claimed to be an independent model invocation
selection_order: Select scout when present and admissible.
Select recon_scout when present and admissible.
From every other admissible non-director role, select at most one dynamic role using the frozen Research OS ordinal scheduler ranking.
Select research_director when present and admissible.
candidate_case_rule: Every candidate linked by any READY request work_item is a case even when the challenger assigns no candidate-linked worker. Explicit no-allocation is recorded as intentionally_unassigned=true and decision KEEP.
representative_task_rule: Otherwise prefer the lexicographically smallest candidate-linked READY task.
Never use response findings to choose the representative task.

decision_rule.KILL: a selected candidate-linked prebuild_killer or chief_falsifier role_result returns FALSIFIED
decision_rule.KEEP: all other candidate cases, including intentional no-allocation
decision_rule.CLOSED_NEGATIVE: not granted to the scheduled worker and may only come from later canonical ground truth

evidence_rule: Challenger counts only benchmark_telemetry belonging to challenger-selected role_results; baseline counts all candidate-linked role_results returned for the request.
